Enable multi-language detection and inspect every ISO 639-3 code that clears the confidence threshold.

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val input = mapper.readValue("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/markdown\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/markdown/comprehensive.md\"}", ExtractInput::class.java)
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language_detection\":{\"detect_multiple\":true,\"enabled\":true,\"min_confidence\":0.3},\"url\":{\"crawl\":{\"ssrf\":{}}}}", ExtractionConfig::class.java)
    val result = Xberg.extract(input, config)
    println(result.results.first().detectedLanguages)
}
```
